# Saved environment for the uboot-env area (mkenvimage -r), written by stone
# at provision time. avocadoctl flips avocado_boot_slot with fw_setenv.
#
# boot-a/boot-b are GPT partitions 1/2; each carries the same
# extlinux/extlinux.conf, whose APPEND says root=PARTLABEL=rootfs-${avocado_boot_slot}
# (U-Boot expands it), so the slot picks the kernel partition and the root.
avocado_boot_slot=a

# Load addresses from U-Boot's default env (include/configs/rk3568_common.h,
# deployed as u-boot-initial-env). A saved environment replaces the default one
# whole, so sysboot and the extlinux loader find none of these unless they are
# here: "Specify a filename" from sysboot is ${scriptaddr} expanding to nothing.
# ponytail: copied, not generated; diff against u-boot-initial-env on a U-Boot
# bump, or generate this file from it if it ever drifts.
scriptaddr=0x00c00000
pxefile_addr_r=0x00e00000
kernel_addr_r=0x02000000
kernel_comp_addr_r=0x0a000000
kernel_comp_size=0x8000000
fdt_addr_r=0x12000000
fdtoverlay_addr_r=0x12100000
ramdisk_addr_r=0x12180000
fdtfile=rockchip/rk3568-nanopi-r5s.dtb

# The disk SPL booted from, per /chosen/u-boot,spl-boot-device: the SD
# controller (mmc1 in U-Boot) or the eMMC (mmc0). The same image is written to
# either, so it can't be a constant here.
avocado_boot_dev=\
  setenv devnum 0;\
  if fdt addr ${fdtcontroladdr}; then\
    if fdt get value spl_dev /chosen u-boot,spl-boot-device; then\
      if test "${spl_dev}" = "/mmc@fe2b0000"; then\
        setenv devnum 1;\
      fi;\
    fi;\
  fi;\
  echo "avocado: boot disk mmc ${devnum}";

# Boot counting for a freshly activated slot. avocadoctl's activate sets
# avocado_boot_tries=3 with the new slot and its commit clears it once the new
# OS verifies; a slot that never gets that far is abandoned here after three
# tries, before any userspace exists to roll it back.
avocado_bootcount=\
  if test -n "${avocado_boot_tries}"; then\
    if test "${avocado_boot_tries}" -le 0; then\
      echo "avocado: slot ${avocado_boot_slot} never committed, rolling back";\
      if test "${avocado_boot_slot}" = "b"; then\
        setenv avocado_boot_slot a;\
      else\
        setenv avocado_boot_slot b;\
      fi;\
      setenv avocado_boot_tries;\
    else\
      setexpr avocado_boot_tries ${avocado_boot_tries} - 1;\
    fi;\
    saveenv;\
  fi;\
  true;

avocado_boot_init=\
  if test "${avocado_boot_slot}" = "b"; then\
    echo "Booting B";\
    setenv bootpart 2;\
  else\
    if test "${avocado_boot_slot}" != "a"; then\
      echo "avocado_boot_slot=${avocado_boot_slot} unset or invalid";\
      setenv avocado_boot_slot a;\
    fi;\
    echo "Booting A";\
    setenv bootpart 1;\
  fi;

avocado_boot=sysboot mmc ${devnum}:${bootpart} any ${scriptaddr} /extlinux/extlinux.conf

bootcmd=run avocado_boot_dev avocado_bootcount avocado_boot_init avocado_boot
